mode: Implementation and release only; all tests, reviews, audits and captures deferred by owner
assignmentRule: One implementation worker per unfinished roadmap leaf; parents aggregate children

items.description: Finish full canonical-section reconciliation and independent review for every identity. The [reconciliation index](docs/planning/canonical-reconciliation.md) maps all 109 identities and 427 current requirements, with bounded independent review. Exhaustive clause/research interpretation and actual consumer admission remain open.

Admit concrete implementation consumers, localized articles/copy, persistence, detailed runtime/capture tuples and tests before each feature is implemented. All 436 records now have explicit planned identities and tuple axes, but reserved paths are not admitted consumers or runtime evidence.

[R (A/D/C admission only)] Admit genuine registered Material Design 3 components and every native/browser/tool adapter: pin provenance, compatibility, licenses, redistributability, offline payloads and full installer size.

[R (A/D/C admission only)] Create deterministic screen/state references, a direct reference renderer and hand-written parity/control maps; include reduced-motion, accessible structured canvas alternatives and negative textbox-substitution checks. Thirty reference states and local build tooling are authored. Two source-bound builds and focused runtime repairs are verified; full reference interaction, accessibility, typography and tuple acceptance remain pending.

[R (A/D/C admission only)] Implement evidence validation that fails red then green when individual implementation, test, article, runtime, capture or parity records are absent or stale; bind proof to source and built artifact hashes.
Guided setup for source or dedicated execution repositories, scoped credentials and compatible hosted/self-hosted Linux runner discovery.
Generate workflows and validate reviewed expert YAML through the same admitted action model.
Queue, observe, cancel, reconnect and download verified outputs from standard public hosted Linux builds.
Independently verify self-hosted Linux execution and explicit runner choice; never auto-select larger billed runners.
Review and extract the generic encrypted-builder engine without private records or secrets; enable transport only after user-selected push and private-repository verification.
Guided/generated and reviewed expert YAML for source or dedicated execution repositories, selecting compatible hosted/self-hosted Windows runners for product builds and packaging.
Produce and verify Windows outputs by invoking exact root `build.bat` and `build-installer.bat` on compatible Windows runners; Linux coordination alone proves no native package.
Publish a normal unique release and verify source, downloadable assets and readback independently from user-build jobs.
[A+R] Replace scaffold assumptions with a reviewed versioned project model, ordered external-tree array, migrations, stable installed identity and isolated per-surface storage.

Improve and verify settings loading, save progress, conflict recovery, unknown-outcome protection and current navigation feedback. Renderer implementation and Linux Chromium fixtures are being verified; updated packaged Windows evidence remains required. Keep this separate from the earlier C02 native receipts.
[A+R] Implement canonical file capabilities with picker/import grants, revalidation, path translation and symlink/reparse/case escape rejection.
[A+R] Implement OS-vault references, reviewed typed host privilege boundaries, least-privilege operation ownership and secret-redacted records.
[A+R] Implement pinned bundled-first dependency discovery/acquisition and root build.bat/build-installer.bat entrypoints with silent mode and nonzero failures.
[A+R] Prove the real fresh-Windows one-command bootstrap/build/run route and interrupted dependency recovery without overwriting existing installations or data.

[A+D-native+R] Implement the productive workspace shell, real window controls, tabs on all four edges, grouping/pinning/reordering/overflow and all discovery searches; use genuine registered Material Design 3 controls, with phone-friendly browser layouts and no generic control substitutes.
[A+D-native+R] Implement complete English/Cantonese/bilingual copy, persisted fresh bilingual/system-theme defaults, independent humor levels, bounded local vocabulary import and display rename.
[A+D-native+R] Implement shared School mode, narration/voice discovery, five ADHD modes, scheduled settings with timezone/DST precedence and required surprise/catalogue behavior.
[A+D-native+R] Implement anchored regex workbenches at every search/picker, Ctrl+Shift+F rich command palette, actual context menus and working shortcut labels from shared action consumers.
[A+D-native+R] Implement every-element appearance editor, continuous color tools, logo derivatives, accessible sizing, motion/reduced motion and bounded overlay/collapse behavior.
[A+D-native+R] Implement guided forms, useful empty-editor presets, settings provenance/help and real rich controls/canvases with keyboard structured equivalents and undo.

[A+D-native+R] Verify A and implemented browser-native D children independently with reload persistence, interaction, component provenance and source-bound captures. C and remaining D child records stay unchecked for PH09; this task does not close the full identity.
[A+D-native+R] Implement exact-destination destructive confirmation with two independent keys, full slider, cancellation and focus return; retain explicit clean-rebuild consent.
[A+D-native+R] Implement reversible per-element experience policies, protected enrollment, support-ticket records and preserved-budget timed unlock ladders; never use these as broker authentication.
[A+D-native+R] Implement standards-tested local authenticators and real QR/manual pairing with protected secret handling.
[A+D-native+R] Implement isolated append-only history, snapshots, restore-as-new-revision, complete scoped exports and protected-data exclusions.
[A+D-native+R] Implement durable jobs, crash/re-entry recovery, progress at initiator, per-item bulk outcomes, cancel/retry and contextual recovery routes.
[A+D-native+R] Implement factual changelog, safe upstream-markup rendering, complete offline documentation and accessible persistent notification/review centre.
[A+D-native+R] Verify retention across failure/restart, cancellation ownership and no automatic cache/source/history pruning; prove free defaults and upstream cost/license disclosure.
[A+R] Implement create/open/adopt/import/clone projects with source/ref/branch status, maintained-LTS recommendation, actual revision provenance and per-project WSL/Docker choice.
[A+R] Implement existing and dedicated managed WSL distribution discovery/provisioning, prerequisite checks and Linux-side storage with Windows browse/export.
[A+R] Implement Docker discovery, managed volumes, isolated non-root execution and truthful container lifecycle/permission recovery.
[A+R] Implement source download/clone/ref acquisition and snapshot/diff/preview/explicit-Apply upgrades with rollback and compatibility boundaries.
[A+R] Implement concurrent per-project queues with global CPU/RAM/storage limits, serialization per canonical output tree, safe process-group/container cancellation and scoped terminals.
[A+R] Verify both runtime adapters on real Buildroot source acquisition and owned execution, including interrupted transfer, missing prerequisites and preserved existing trees.
[A+R] Bridge authoritative Buildroot Kconfig semantics through a pinned admitted library and actual make olddefconfig; expose full menus/types/choices/ranges/dependencies/help.
[A+R] Implement typed configuration controls and immediate queued reconciliation with requested/effective diff, atomic snapshots, undo ordering and failure restoration.
[A+R] Implement full Linux kernel, BusyBox and U-Boot configuration domains with the same real semantics and revision-bound behavior.
[A+R] Implement real defconfig browsing/apply/minimal-save provenance, ordered external trees and separate output directories.
[A+R] Implement complete package source/build/hash/license/dependency editors, ordered patch/hook workflows, overlays with mappings/permissions and discovered external-editor handoff.
[A+R] Implement named build/package/clean targets, truthful streaming logs/history/progress and explicit invalidation/rebuild explanations.
[A+R] Verify real source-to-image builds in WSL and Docker, rapid-edit race/rollback behavior and interaction tests rejecting generic textbox substitutions.
[A+R] Implement minimal/desktop/server/appliance presets and genuinely supported desktop/compositor previews with account/SSH provisioning and protected credentials.
[A+R] Implement safe artifact viewers, checksums/graphs/licenses, filesystem/archive/image inspection, disk/partition canvas and validated ISO/VMDK/VDI/OVA conversion/export.
[A+R] Implement VMware Workstation and VirtualBox discovery/create/import/hardware/storage/network/firmware edit/launch/stop with topology controls, NAT default and advanced network options.

[A+R] Prove real x86_64 BIOS and UEFI guest boot, login/console, networking, disk persistence and graceful shutdown on both observed current-stable hypervisors; record actual versions and no Secure Boot claim.
[A+R] Implement source/config locks, manifests, hashes, SBOM/license outputs and repeat-build comparisons with explicit nonreproducible differences.
[A+R] Implement real SDK/toolchain export with consumer smoke-build verification and environment instructions.
[A+R] After P42, implement exact destination-validated flashing and guest installer routes with reviewed destructive actions, cancellation and recovery proof.
[A+R] After P41, implement authenticated remote runtime enrollment, transfer/jobs/cancel/recovery/output verification for the approved target types.
[A+R] After P40, implement approved cloud providers/destinations with scoped vault credentials, previewed upload, checksums, cancel/retry and actual provider readback.
[A+D-native+R] Implement all eight converter categories and PDF operations with packaged offline adapters, searchable rich controls and unlimited disk-backed paged queues; validate genuine outputs.
[A+D-native+R] Implement Java/Bedrock version/flavour/plugin discovery and rich Minecraft server creation/configuration/lifecycle across local process, local container, SSH process and SSH container.
[A+D-native+R] Implement Ollama discovery and one-click managed install/recovery, full catalogue/tags/hardware fit, durable model pulls and streamed chat preserving existing models.
[A+D-native+R] Implement local assistant plans/checkpoints/reviewed actions and harness recovery with no silent privilege escalation; verify failure and cancellation phases.
[A+D-native+R] Implement actual external-editor handoff and browser transfer start/progress/completion surfaces with real queue consumers, recovery and supported focus/visibility behavior.
[A+D-native+R] Implement previewed authenticated forge publication with exact destination/source, scoped credentials and actual readback.

[A+D-native+R] Verify every A tool and each implemented browser-native D tool using separate runtime/output/persistence/capture proof, including offline missing-payload and partial-result behavior. C and remaining D records stay unchecked for PH09; full identity closure waits for all applicable records.
[A+D+C+R (through-PH09 scope)] Complete D browser-native implementations for every applicable identity, with local visitor state, reset/export explanations and truthful unavailable/offline behavior.

[A+D+C+R (through-PH09 scope)] Implement reviewed explicit Edge/Chrome pairing and authenticated LAN capability grants/revocation with origin, TLS, CSRF/replay and browser private-network handling; no internet control exposure.
[A+D+C+R (through-PH09 scope)] Complete C typed broker consumers and independent client state for every applicable identity; revocation stops new authority and settles owned jobs truthfully.

[A+D+C+R (through-PH09 scope)] Complete detailed categorized feature articles and Cantonese twins, rendered source wiki, search/offline navigation and actual API Postman category/master collections; distinguish non-HTTP IPC.
[A+D+C+R (through-PH09 scope)] Complete vendored licensed/hashed fonts, safe shared-link metadata, genuine screenshot/gallery/recording presentation and current source-bound front provenance.

[A+D+C+R (through-PH09 scope)] Implement authenticated status integration and truthful unavailable states; verify authorized status bridge, protected webhooks and display-event delivery with separate R evidence.

[A+D+C+R (through-PH09 scope)] Run independent A/D/C identity and state/persistence audits for capabilities implemented through PH09, plus normal/minimum × three languages × two themes × four scales, pure registered Material Design 3 controls and phone-friendly touch/keyboard checks from approximately 320px. Keep PH10 installer/update/download-dependent records unchecked until PH10 final acceptance.

[A+D+C+R (through-PH09 scope)] Prove exact-boundary completeness and design-reference guards red then green by removing one required record at a time; all missing runtime, hosted, permission or platform evidence remains open. PH10-dependent records are explicitly pending, not waived or treated as passed.

[A+D+C+R (final applicable acceptance)] Assemble one complete Windows x64 installer with all required capability payloads, original installed icons, valid license disclosures and actual offline bundled-first discovery.
[A+D+C+R (final applicable acceptance)] Produce real unsigned Squirrel.Windows Setup.exe, RELEASES, full packages and deltas; apply only required project-owned signing without claiming public trust.

[A+D+C+R (final applicable acceptance)] Verify actual current physical Windows host installation/launch, preservation, cancellation, update/rollback and unsaved-state handling; record fresh-environment and uninstall proof separately when actually available.
[A+D+C+R (final applicable acceptance)] Implement background update discovery/download with an unsigned-ready banner and explicit restart; exercise real version transitions and recovery.

[A+D+C+R (final applicable acceptance)] Implement CI bootstrap inventories, compatible accessible runner selection/cloud fallback and defensive evidence collection; use encrypted public builder transport only if private source is introduced.

[A+D+C+R (final applicable acceptance)] Publish uniquely tagged normal releases with verified installer assets, workflow timing and line counts, factual catalogue-linked naming and resolved permitted release-photo policy; read back draft=false/prerelease=false.

[A+D+C+R (final applicable acceptance)] Verify live downloads against expected source/version/checksums and complete homepage/wiki/articles/screenshots/gallery links; synchronize repository records, supported discussions/project item and sanitized guidance.

[A+D+C+R (final applicable acceptance)] Publish the verified operating procedure, grounded human-effort estimate and source-bound final handoff/issue/next-session prompt; reconcile every applicable child and all 109 dispositions before declaring complete.
